correctness.rationale: Two definitionally independent predicates agree on every 12-bit face mask at both levels. Two complete acyclic Morse matchings per level are verified over all 264/1524 cover incidences, leaving one vertex plus 4 dimension-two or 32 dimension-three cells. Direct original-chain and relative-chain mod-two ranks agree; Morse gives the integral homotopy. Null inclusion and wedge cofiber follow from the 2-connectivity of the target and the cofibration property of simplicial inclusions.

value.rationale: A complete natural transition in a graph-filtration: 12-vertex cuboctahedron has a nonpure four-dimensional first forest complex but 32 three-spheres, and its inclusion of the known four-two-sphere level-zero stage is null with exact 36-three-sphere cofiber. These are nontrivial integral homotopy facts for a canonical graph and give a benchmark for comparisons of adjacent graph-complex filtration stages, without claiming a general theorem.
